Block 01 · As is

Cost per piece

Monthly cost divided by units delivered. The number that matters most if you're deciding whether to run this in your market.

By content type

Not every piece costs the same. This is where the average comes from.

Content typeUnitsShare of outputAvg. cost per pieceAvg. TAT

*Cost per piece is monthly contracted cost divided by units delivered in that month. It is an operational average, not a rate card.

What moves this number

Volume, mix and repeat work. A month of high-volume FAQ output and a month of heavy video production produce very different averages from the same cost base.

Block 02 · Going beyond

Creative work

Three pieces of work this year that went past the brief, plus the steady output that runs underneath all of it.

HIGHLIGHT 01

Service Awards toolkit

Rolled out across Europe

Every market was announcing its awards differently. We built one design system for the whole of Europe, so that when a subsidiary wins something, the work is already done.

Each award comes with a ready asset pack built to the new Samsung brand guidelines: support banners, social posts, stories, email modules and video end frames. Drop in the award name and publish.

  • One visual language for every European market
  • Built to the latest Samsung brand guidelines
  • Covers support pages, social, email and video
  • Template based, so a market needs no design resource
  • Award name and year are the only variables

The full pack: support banners, social formats, stories, print and video end frames, all from one system.

The pack includes a motion end frame so the award shows up in video as well as on the page. Same system, same build, no extra brief.

Awards short ↗Vertical cut for social.

HIGHLIGHT 02

Samsung Services, unified

Landing page in production

EHQ asked for one look and feel across the service propositions: Self Repair, Van Service, Premium Plus and Live Chat. Each had grown its own style.

We presented several directions. EHQ chose the 3D asset route with a Samsung support blue reserved for our pages, so service content is recognisable the moment it loads. The landing page that brings it all together is being built now.

  • Brief from EHQ: one identity for all service propositions
  • Several directions presented, one selected
  • 3D illustration with a dedicated support blue
  • Applied to Self Repair, Van Service, Premium Plus, Live Chat
  • Central landing page currently in production

One system, four propositions. The line stays the same so the service changes, not the promise.

Campaign banner using the same language.

Module format for service pages.

p6-qa.samsung.com/test/support/samsung-service/

The landing page in QA. Scroll inside the frame to see it end to end.

HIGHLIGHT 03

Switching to Samsung

Awaiting EHQ approval

Smart Switch is well covered for recent devices and thin for older models, which is exactly where the people who need it most are coming from.

We built a campaign around that gap: a long-form film for the full process, a short for social, and a banner set to drive to both. It is finished and waiting on the green light.

  • Focused on older devices, where the guidance was thinnest
  • Long-form film plus a vertical short
  • Banner set produced to support both
  • Produced end to end in house
  • Ready to publish on approval
Switching to Samsung ↗Long form, horizontal. The full Smart Switch process.
Short ↗Vertical cut for social.

AI in the production line

Samsung put AI in front of the question with suggested searches. We put it behind the answer: drafting, variants, localisation support, versioning. It changed how fast we answer, not who decides what the answer is.

how do i…
AI Suggested Searches
how do i connect my dryer to SmartThings
how do i transfer my data to a new Galaxy
how do i stop white residue on my dishes

Block 03

What's next

Two proposals. Neither is live. Both are concepts we'd like to build with you, and both aim straight at the cost-per-piece and turnaround numbers in block one.

Concept

Support chatbot

A conversational layer on top of the support library. It does not replace the pages. It is only as good as the content underneath it, which is exactly why it raises the value of the content work rather than reducing it.

[ What it would need from us, what it would need from you, and what it would change. ]

Concept

Proofreading agent

An automated pass for accuracy, tone, terminology and brand compliance before a page reaches QA. It targets the slowest step in the request flow and the most repetitive part of the cost base.

[ What it checks, what it never decides, and the TAT it would take out. ]

Pre-QA check
✓ Terminology matches market glossary
✓ Model names and variants verified
! Tone drifts from support voice in 2 places
! Legal line missing for this market
